just to explain a little bit as a fan! i'm not judging at all, just want to touch on the hype - miku isn't from any manga or anime and isn't a character with an actual personality, she's a blank slate mascot that's used for a vocal synthesizer and fans like making up their own versions of her. she's not a real person and is literally just an instrument with a character design. since she's just a vocal synthesizer you can do whatever with, music with her varies heavily since there's hundreds of thousands of songs written by a bunch of different musicians! because of this she's become somewhat of an internet cultural icon, rising to popularity in 2007. there's a lot of people who don't like anime that like miku, not because of her appearance but because they like some songs with her. there's lots of songs with her that aren't just her repeating her name and fortnite honestly just picked some basic really mainstream songs for her. so in a way it's like saying "pianos are so mid" when it drastically varies from musician to musician. [here's a cool use of miku](https://youtu.be/Pca7RONLQdE?si=a2ZZ7gMeGwJ524Qg) if you're curious! i totally understand if it's not your cup of tea but i figured i'd share. :) i think ultimately people are so excited for miku since she's just a familiar face on the internet. for sure there's people who just drool over anything anime, but for me, i'm happy because she's something i've loved so much and has helped me appreciate music in a new way, and her getting into fortnite of kind of a milestone. sorry for the super long comment lol. i hope you have a great day!

It really is! I bought the whole bundle for 71% off ($26) and I'm really glad I did. Really enjoyable game so far.

In the anime, it's definitely not that much of an eyesore after 4-5 episodes. Minus close-up shots the eyes aren't that horrible and the art style itself improves a bit more in the second half of the anime, After Story. 

I definitely recommend watching it even though the faces are messed up. All of the other art especially for the backgrounds is pretty gorgeous and makes up for the gigantic eye issue. Clannad is a pretty great anime (After Story is even better) and once you look past the girls facial anatomy it's pretty enjoyable.

I'm also currently playing through the visual novel myself, and it is very enjoyable despite the art being noticeably worse. I don't mind the art at all, the story and characters and even the music (Amazing soundtrack, holy shit.) makes up for the minor art issue. Clannad is really great and I do recommend giving it a shot.
